subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your recent flight booking from New York to Los Angeles. Your flight details are as follows: - Departure: June 15th, 2022 at 10:00 AM - Arrival: June 15th, 2022 at 1:00 PM - Flight Number: XYZ123 Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
